metadata.title: Monochrome Pop Portrait with Dual Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome studio portrait featuring a central subject in a seated pose with a mix of delicate script and bold wide-spaced serif typography.
triggerTerms: high-key white accents on dark grey
excludeWhen: busy or outdoor backgrounds are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A grayscale studio photograph of a female figure with a high ponytail, seated on a white stool against a seamless grey background. The composition is anchored by the subject's vertical posture and balanced by horizontal text that spans the lower third of the frame, utilizing a contrast between organic handwriting and rigid geometric type.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically on a white stool
Horizontal text line bisecting the lower torso area
Contrast between dark lace clothing and bright white footwear
Soft directional lighting creating smooth gradients on skin
coreInvariants: Dual-style typography across a single horizontal axis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body seated subject, centered, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white stool and matching heels at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the line of the arm down to the white shoes, then move horizontally across the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of uniform medium-grey on the left and right sides to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Medium grey background and skin tones
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for the stool and shoes; pale pink for script text
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation for the image; high value contrast between the white stool and the dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Single pastel accent color for script text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A combination of a thin, flowing cursive and a wide, geometric serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Continuous stroke, low contrast, slanted, organic loops.
Serif: High horizontal expansion, sharp triangular serifs, uniform stroke weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extreme tracking/letter-spacing for the serif font to create a cinematic feel.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the subject's hip area
placed over the background and subject's arm

graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment across the lower third

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, sharp-serif aesthetic for the primary name.
Provides the necessary delicate, personal touch for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grayscale studio portrait of a woman with a high ponytail, wearing dark lace apparel, seated on a bright white wooden stool against a medium-grey seamless backdrop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a horizontal line of text in the lower third. On the left, use a thin pale pink script. On the right, use a wide-spaced, all-caps white serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly grayscale except for the pink text?
Is the serif text significantly letter-spaced?
Is the stool and footwear the brightest point of the image?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pink accent color
Amount of letter-spacing in the serif font
mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific artist names or logos
Ensure the script text is legible against the subject's arm

mustAchieve: Clean studio lighting with soft shadows
Perfect horizontal alignment of disparate text styles

postGenerationChecks: Check for monochrome consistency in the subject
Ensure the white stool doesn't blow out details
Confirm the script font remains thin and delicate
recipe.reuseFormula: Seated monochrome portrait + [Subject Description] + Wide-spaced Serif + Delicate Script Overlay.
